import sys

def find_longest_palindrome(s):
    n = len(s)
    max_length = 0
    best_palindrome = ""
    
    for i in range(n + 1):
        prefix = s[:i]
        reversed_prefix = prefix[::-1]
        if s.endswith(reversed_prefix) and len(prefix) > max_length:
            max_length = len(prefix)
            best_palindrome = prefix
    
    return best_palindrome
